title: What became of Nat Towles and his refusal to go to New York
summary: Towles moved to California and kept a small group; he would not bring the band to New York.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Nat's band? Well, Nat really didn't fold -- he worked like -- he had moved to California and he worked up until he died with his band. He --
Well, Nat's been dead about eight years, eight or nine years.
He kept the band up all these decades?

He was a bass player, but he had given it up to direct and his cousin played bass with us, he was another Blanton, really. He was really ahead of his time, Gary. And he wanted to come to New York so badly until he just really lost his mind because he didn't get to New York and Nat wouldn't

come to New York. We used to beg him to come to New York. We said, 'Man, let's go. Just take a chance.' And he says, 'We'll get some work.' So he used to say, 'No, I'd rather be a big fish in a little pond than be a little fish in a big pond.' That was always what he'd always say to us, you know. And we couldn't get him to come to New York.
